review_description: Fantastic service to perfection.Polite, tidy, punctual no issues at all

Photon Energy Solutions exceeded my expectations in every aspect. Their professionalism was exemplary, guiding me through the process with expertise and care.Vishal the lead man/ owner provided the best product, perfectly tailored to my needs and future-proofing my investment.The workmanship displayed during installation was outstanding, with attention to detail evident in every step. And to top it off, the overall value for money was unbeatable, offering long-term savings and peace of mind.I highly recommend Photon Energy Solutions to anyone looking for top-notch solar solutions. Vishal has truly set the standard for excellence in the industry.

Got reference from my dad who had panel installed from Photon Energy Solutions and then I rang them. Found the prices quite reasonable. The guy actually did an inspection of the roof and designed a customized product that met all of my requirements. Photon delivered on their promises, also provided excellent post-installation support and help with Powershop in linking my solar with them. My electric bills have almost disappeard. Thanks to Photon.

Photon Energy Solutions installed my solar system last year. I found them extremely competitive and professional.One standout feature of Photon Energy Solutions is their commitment to customer satisfaction. My personal experience with them was nothing short of excellent. From the initial consultation to the installation process, the team demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine passion for solar energy solutions.They helped me make a positive impact on the environment while also saving on electricity bills.Overall, I highly recommend Photon Energy Solutions to anyone looking to invest in solar energy. Their dedication to customer service, coupled with their superior products, make them a top choice in the industry.

Attention to detail and excellent service from the time of initial enquiry followed by site visit and discussion of options in the proposal.The team is receptive of customer requirements but at the same time takes time to explain all available options .Highly experienced and knowledgeable team. Give them a call to discuss your requirements.

I recently had solar panels installed by photon energy solutions and I couldn't be happier with the results. The entire process from start to finish was seamless and the customer service was top-notch. The installation team was professional and efficient, and the panels are already saving me money on my energy bills.I highly recommend photon energy solutions to anyone looking to go solar.

Extremely happy with the service provided, the end to end service from quality of panelto the number of panels was spot on. I have not paid the electricity bill for the last 1 year.the team followed up regularly on the performance   and the cost was the most competitive in the  market. I highly recommend    the team for solar installation and consultation.

I cannot say enough positive things about my experience with Photon.I found the team professional, knowledgeable, and honest. They took the time to fully explain the product, pricing and installation process and answer all of my questions.The installation was on time as promised and a smooth process. The crew was very respectful of my property.The system has been up and running for a few months now and I am already seeing significant savings on my summer bills.I am thrilled with the decision to go solar and even more thrilled with my choice to work with Photon Energy Solutions because of the service I received.I would happily recommend them to anyone looking to get solar. Their expertise and customer service are second to none.I am so grateful for the positive impact they have had on my home and my wallet.

My overall experience with Photon Energy Solutions was very pleasant. The installation team was professional, and the experience was great. We received exactly what was promised. A detailed quotation was provided, and the installer was extremely helpful with all my queries.I would highly recommend Photon Energy Solutions to anyone looking at purchasing Solar.
